view.description: Autoresearch loop for render speed. Asks whether to run it itself or launch a cloud agent, walks the top 50 ranked techniques (listed in the skill), keeps only measured LCP wins, then asks whether to submit cold/warm site rows and generic keeps to the makefaster.dev leaderboard.

memory.content: North star is LCP (cold + warm, median of at least 3 runs). Keep a change only if it beats the measured noise floor and at least 5% or 20ms. An FCP-only win that regresses LCP does not count.
Never merge. Never force-push. Open a pull request only when there is a measured keep.
Walk the live ranked improvement checklist in rank order (top 50), then up to 5 extras. No miss-streak stop. Generic technique names only.

Do not name the public leaderboard site until the run is finished. Then ask whether to submit results to https://makefaster.dev (POST /api/submit-site for cold and warm, POST /api/submit-improvements for generic keeps).
